# repeated cv,  not 5 fold only!   repeat 500
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(compositions)   # CLR transformation

## continue
physeq <- readRDS("../Output/physeq.rds")

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)
otu  <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq))

# Fix survival time = 0 → 1 (otherwise Cox model will get error)
meta$survival_months[ meta$Sample_id == "D1413D" ] <- 1


## OTU table
if (taxa_are_rows(physeq)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
  otu <- as.data.frame(otu)
}

meta$sampleID <- rownames(meta)
otu$sampleID  <- rownames(otu)

## Prevalence filter 10%

otu_only <- otu %>% select(-sampleID)
otu_only <- as.data.frame(otu_only)

min_prevalence <- ceiling(0.10 * nrow(otu_only))
keep_taxa <- names(which(colSums(otu_only > 0) >= min_prevalence))

otu_filt <- otu_only[, keep_taxa, drop = FALSE]
cat("Taxa after filtering:", length(keep_taxa), "\n")

##  CLR transformation
otu_filt_num <- apply(otu_filt, 2, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
otu_filt_num <- as.data.frame(otu_filt_num)

otu_clr_mat <- clr(otu_filt_num + 1e-6) # aviod log0
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_clr_mat)

otu_clr$sampleID <- rownames(otu_filt)

## Merge with metadata 
dat <- merge(meta, otu_clr, by = "sampleID")

time_col   <- "survival_months"
status_col <- "vital_status"
age_col    <- "age_MBC_dx"

taxa <- keep_taxa

X <- as.matrix(dat[, taxa])
y <- Surv(dat[[time_col]], dat[[status_col]])

## ======================  500 Repeated 5-fold CV  ====================
n_repeats <- 500      # repeat 500 
alpha_val <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)
nfolds_val <- 5

p <- ncol(X)
feature_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_repeats, ncol = p)
colnames(feature_mat) <- taxa

lambda_vec <- numeric(n_repeats)
cindex_vec <- numeric(n_repeats)
alpha_vec  <- numeric(n_repeats)

for (i in 1:n_repeats) {

  # Randomly pick an alpha 
  a <- sample(alpha_val, 1)
  alpha_vec[i] <- a

  set.seed(1000 + i)
  cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
    X, y,
    family = "cox",
    alpha = a,
    type.measure = "C",
    nfolds = nfolds_val
  )

  lambda_vec[i] <- cvfit$lambda.min
  cindex_vec[i] <- max(cvfit$cvm)

  # Refit the model with best lambda 
  fit_i <- glmnet(
    X, y,
    family = "cox",
    alpha = a,
    lambda = cvfit$lambda.min
  )

  coef_i <- as.numeric(coef(fit_i))
  feature_mat[i, ] <- coef_i != 0
}

## feature selection frequency 
freq <- colSums(feature_mat) / n_repeats
freq_df <- data.frame(taxon = taxa, freq = freq)
freq_df <- freq_df[order(-freq_df$freq), ]

print(head(freq_df, 20))

## Choose stable features (freq > 0.5 )
stable_features <- freq_df$taxon[freq_df$freq > 0.5]

cat("Stable selected taxa:", length(stable_features), "\n")
print(stable_features)


## final Elastic-Net Cox model on full dataset
X_final <- as.matrix(dat[, stable_features])

final_model <- coxph(
  Surv(dat[[time_col]], dat[[status_col]]) ~ .,
  data = as.data.frame(X_final)
)

summary(final_model)


## risk score
risk_score <- predict(final_model, type = "lp")  
dat$risk_score <- risk_score
## multivariable Cox with adjustment ,   not necessary
fit_multi <- coxph(
  Surv(dat[[time_col]], dat[[status_col]]) ~ risk_score + dat[[age_col]],
  data = dat
)
summary(fit_multi)
```

s

p_km$plot <- p_km$plot +

             label = hr_txt,
             #size = 4.8

p_km

p_km

# Fig5c
```{r}
library(timeROC)
# 1: age + ER + race 
fit_m1 <- coxph(Surv(dat[[time_col]], dat[[status_col]]) ~ age_group + ER + race, data = dat)
dat$score_m1 <- predict(fit_m1, type="lp")
td_m1 <- timeROC(T=dat[[time_col]], delta=dat[[status_col]], marker=dat$score_m1,
                 cause=1, times=c(12,36), iid=TRUE)


# 2: risk score only
td_m2 <- timeROC(T=dat[[time_col]], delta=dat[[status_col]],
                 marker=dat$risk_score,
                 cause=1, times=c(12,36), iid=TRUE)


#  3: risk score +  age + ER + race 
fit_m3 <- coxph(Surv(dat[[time_col]], dat[[status_col]]) ~ risk_score + age_group + ER + race, data=dat)
dat$score_m3 <- predict(fit_m3, type="lp")
td_m3 <- timeROC(T=dat[[time_col]], delta=dat[[status_col]], marker=dat$score_m3,
                 cause=1, times=c(12,36), iid=TRUE)

df_roc <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(FP = td_m1$FP[,2], TP = td_m1$TP[,2], Model="Age+ER+Race"),
  data.frame(FP = td_m2$FP[,2], TP = td_m2$TP[,2], Model="Risk score"),
  data.frame(FP = td_m3$FP[,2], TP = td_m3$TP[,2], Model="Combined model")
)
df_roc$Model <- factor(df_roc$Model,
                       levels = c("Age+ER+Race", "Risk score", "Combined model"))
AUC1 <- td_m1$AUC[2]
AUC2 <- td_m2$AUC[2]
AUC3 <- td_m3$AUC[2]

## CI band function
boot_roc <- function(data, marker, B=300){
  fp_grid <- seq(0,1,length.out=100)   # 
  tp_boot <- matrix(NA,100,B)

  for(i in 1:B){
    idx <- sample(1:nrow(data), replace=TRUE)
    d2  <- data[idx,]

    td <- try(timeROC(T=d2[[time_col]], delta=d2[[status_col]],
                      marker=d2[[marker]], cause=1, times=36),silent=T)
    if(class(td)=="try-error") next
    tp_boot[,i] <- approx(td$FP[,2], td$TP[,2], xout = fp_grid, rule=2)$y
  }

  tibble(
    FP      = fp_grid,
    TP_mean = rowMeans(tp_boot, na.rm=T),
    TP_low  = apply(tp_boot,1,quantile,0.025,na.rm=T),
    TP_high = apply(tp_boot,1,quantile,0.975,na.rm=T)
  )
}

ci_m1 <- boot_roc(dat,"score_m1")
ci_m2 <- boot_roc(dat,"risk_score")
ci_m3 <- boot_roc(dat,"score_m3")

ci_m1$Model="Age+ER+Race"
ci_m2$Model="Risk score"
ci_m3$Model="Combined model"

df_ci <- bind_rows(ci_m1,ci_m2,ci_m3)
df_ci$Model <- factor(df_ci$Model,
                      levels=c("Age+ER+Race","Risk score","Combined model"))

df_ci$Model <- factor(df_ci$Model,
                      levels=c("Age+ER+Race","Risk score","Combined model"))
df_roc$Model <- factor(df_roc$Model,
                      levels=c("Age+ER+Race","Risk score","Combined model"))

#plot
cols = c("Age+ER+Race"="#314295",  
         "Risk score"      ="#E64A63",  
         "Combined model"        ="#2A9D8F")  
legend_labels <- c(
  "Age+ER+Race"   = sprintf("Age+ER+Race (AUC = %.2f)", AUC1),
  "Risk score"    = sprintf("Risk score (AUC = %.2f)",   AUC2),
  "Combined model"= sprintf("Combined model (AUC = %.2f)", AUC3)
)


p_roc <- ggplot(df_roc, aes(x = FP, y = TP, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-0.01, 1.01), ylim = c(-0.01, 1.01), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols,
                     labels = legend_labels) +
  labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    text             = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position  = c(0.6, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8), color = NA),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10)
  )+
    geom_ribbon(data=df_ci,
              aes(x=FP,ymin=TP_low,ymax=TP_high,fill=Model),
              alpha=0.10,inherit.aes=FALSE)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=cols,guide="none")


p_roc
ggsave("../Output/Survival/ROC_36m.pdf",p_roc,width=4.5,height=4)
```


# Fig5 a
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

## 1Extract Cox model results: coef, HR, CI, p-value
# final_model is the fitted Cox model using the stable taxa.
s <- summary(final_model)

# Clean table of coefficients and hazard ratios
coef_tab <- data.frame(
  taxon   = gsub("`", "", rownames(s$coefficients)),  
  coef    = s$coefficients[, "coef"],
  se      = s$coefficients[, "se(coef)"],
  z       = s$coefficients[, "z"],
  p       = s$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  HR      = s$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
  HR_low  = s$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
  HR_up   = s$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

## Merge repeated CV selection frequency results
# freq_df: taxon, freq (0–1)
# n_repeats: number of repeated CV runs 
res_df <- freq_df %>%
  filter(taxon %in% stable_features) %>%          # keep only stable taxa
  mutate(n_selected = freq * n_repeats) %>%       # convert frequency → absolute count
  left_join(coef_tab, by = "taxon") %>%           # merge Cox model results
  mutate(
    risk_dir = ifelse(coef > 0, "High risk", "Low risk")   # direction of risk
  )

## Extract clean species names
# Use only the last element of the taxonomic path (species level)
res_df <- res_df %>%
  mutate(
    species_raw = sapply(strsplit(taxon, ";"), function(x) tail(x, 1)),
    species     = gsub("_", " ", species_raw)  # prettier labels
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(coef)) %>%                        # order taxa by coefficient
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = rev(unique(species))))


# theme 
base_size_common <- 14

# Left panel
p_freq <- ggplot(res_df,
                 aes(x = n_selected, y = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab("Number of times selected") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size_common) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", color = "black"),  
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85")
  )
p_freq
## middle panel
p_hr <- ggplot(res_df,
               aes(x = HR, y = species)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +       
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = HR_low, xmax = HR_up), height = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +                                       
  xlab("Hazard Ratio (95% CI)") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size_common) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),       
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85")
  )
p_hr
## right panel
cols <- c("High risk" = "#E64A63", "Low risk" = "#314295")

p_coef <- ggplot(res_df,
                 aes(x = coef, y = species, fill = risk_dir)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient",
    y = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size_common) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),         
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.05),       
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8), color = NA)
  )


## merge
p_all <- plot_grid(
  p_freq, p_hr, p_coef,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(1.2, 0.6, 1),   
  align = "h",                     
  axis  = "tb"                     
)

p_all

ggsave("../Output/Survival/Fig2_species.pdf",
       p_all, width = 10, height = 3)

```

#Fig5d
```{r}
# SHAP
library(kernelshap)
library(shapviz)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

##  Prepare the taxa list + coefficients from final_model
# Ensure stable_features matches actual column names in dat
stable_features <- intersect(stable_features, colnames(dat))

# Extract Cox model coefficients and clean their names
sel_coefs <- coef(final_model)
names(sel_coefs) <- gsub("`", "", names(sel_coefs))   

# Keep only coefficients corresponding to stable features
sel_coefs <- sel_coefs[names(sel_coefs) %in% stable_features]

# Build species-level signature table
signature_df <- data.frame(
  taxon = stable_features,
  coef  = sel_coefs[stable_features],   # correctly aligned after the fix
  row.names = NULL
)

# Extract species names (last taxonomic level)
signature_df$species_raw   <- sapply(strsplit(signature_df$taxon, ";"), tail, 1)
signature_df$species_clean <- gsub("_", " ", signature_df$species_raw)

# Map full taxonomy → clean species name
taxon_to_species <- setNames(signature_df$species_clean, signature_df$taxon)



##  Prepare X_shap using stable_features only
# Extract CLR abundance matrix for the selected stable taxa
X_shap <- as.data.frame(dat[, stable_features, drop = FALSE])
# Rename columns to clean species names 
colnames(X_shap) <- taxon_to_species[colnames(X_shap)]

## Enforce SAME species order as Fig5d 
species_order <- as.character(res_df$species)
species_order <- levels(res_df$species)   # revse order
# Keep only species that exist in X_shap (safety check)
species_order <- species_order[species_order %in% colnames(X_shap)]

# Reorder columns of X_shap to match coef-sorted order
X_shap <- X_shap[, species_order, drop = FALSE]

## Background data for KernelSHAP (20 samples)
set.seed(123)
bg <- X_shap[sample(1:nrow(X_shap), 20), , drop = FALSE]


##  Fit SHAP model 
fit_shap <- lm(risk_score ~ ., data = cbind(risk_score = dat$risk_score, X_shap))

## KernelSHAP + shapviz
sh <- kernelshap(
  object = fit_shap,
  X      = X_shap,
  bg_X   = bg
)

sv <- shapviz(sh, X = X_shap)

## SHAP plot
base_size_common <- 14
cols_risk <- c("#314295", "#E64A63")

p_shap <- sv_importance(
  sv,
  max_display  = length(species_order),
  kind         = "beeswarm",
  viridis_args = list(option = "inferno"),
  
  sort         = FALSE
) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = species_order) +
  labs(
    x = "SHAP value",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size_common) +
  theme(
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line    = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
  )
p_shap

ggsave("../Output/Survival/SHAP_beeswarm_coefsame.pdf",
       p_shap, width = 7, height = 5)


##  Heatmap --abundance
sig_abundance <- dat[, stable_features]
rownames(sig_abundance) <- dat$sampleID
colnames(sig_abundance) <- taxon_to_species[colnames(sig_abundance)]
sig_abundance <- sig_abundance[, species_order]

order_idx <- order(dat$risk_group, decreasing = TRUE)
sig_abundance <- sig_abundance[order_idx, ]

ann <- data.frame(RiskGroup = dat$risk_group[order_idx])
rownames(ann) <- rownames(sig_abundance)

heat_mat <- t(sig_abundance)
heat_mat <- heat_mat[species_order, ]

cols_group <- c("High risk" = "#E64A63", "Low risk" = "#314295")

pdf("../Output/Survival/p_heatmap_signature.pdf", width = 7, height = 2.5)
pheatmap(
  heat_mat,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_col = ann,
  annotation_colors = list(RiskGroup = cols_group),
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#3F1B77", "#FFFFFF", "#D4A017"))(100)
)
dev.off()


```
